changelog: THE GAME IS NOW CALLED TABLE OF WAR. War Table was taken in every place that mattered — an existing Steam page, a Google Play app and an itch entry, with a registered TABLEWAR mark alongside them. IMPORTANT: this is a clean break, not an update. The app identity changed with the name, so Android and Windows treat this as a separate application — it installs alongside your old copy rather than over it, and starts with a fresh profile. Your progress stays in the old install; uninstall it once you have moved across. This is the last time that happens. New title plaque throughout, and the update feed moves with the name.
